subject.title: fix(security): close active April 4 transport and auth gaps

question: What security policy should this PR land with for explicit proxies, shared-auth rotation, and Discord mentions on current main?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not only mechanical conflicts: fail-closed proxy validation, active-session eviction timing, and broad Discord mention suppression all change security and delivery boundaries that need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Rebase Into Current Security Seams
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, use DNS-aware proxy-host checks, pass shared-auth disconnect intent through commitGatewayConfigWrite, and apply one approved Discord mention policy across text/media/payload/poll surfaces.

options.title: Accept Broad Fail-Closed Behavior
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept stricter proxy rejection and blanket mention suppression, but should document upgrade and delivery impact before merge.

options.title: Split Or Retire The Stale Branch
options.body: If rebasing keeps mixing unrelated security concerns, replace this branch with smaller current-main PRs for the remaining valid gaps.

recommendation.title: Rebase Into Current Security Seams
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, use DNS-aware proxy-host checks, pass shared-auth disconnect intent through commitGatewayConfigWrite, and apply one approved Discord mention policy across text/media/payload/poll surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the branch and the prior request transport work, and is the best available owner to choose the current-main repair shape before broader review.
